Name: DKT Connectome
Description: QSIPrep → optional lesion inpainting (neuroLIT) → FreeSurfer/FastSurfer → QSIRecon ACT-HSVS tractography → DKT structural connectome → optional disconnectome (Step 4.1) → node-strength report.
Author: University of Rochester Medical Center
